title: Surgeon-Patient Communication: A Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating the Impact of an Orthopaedic Related Smoking Cessation Discussion After Fracture Surgery
brief_summary: In this study, the investigators are interested in evaluating the impact of an orthopaedic related smoking cessation discussion after fracture surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients 18 year old or older,
* daily smoker
* inpatient post fracture operation,
* patient that have never received an orthopaedic related smoking cessation discussion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Younger than 18,
* patients unable to provide consent
* patients that suffer from auditory/visual/mental disability requiring another individual as a decision-maker
